The three steps were merged into a single self-contained script organized sequentially into data preparation and stain-invariant histopathology augmentation, domain-invariant multi-scale ConvNeXt model and loss definitions, and mixed-precision training, evaluation, optional post-selection refitting, and submission generation. Duplicate imports and redundant DataLoader instantiations were consolidated by initializing the primary DataLoaders once with `return_train_meta=True` for training-only Class-Conditional CORAL alignment while keeping validation and test strictly pixel-only and identical through 8-view $D_4$ dihedral TTA. Execution is wrapped cleanly inside `main()` with safe checkpoint loading and memory cleanup prior to refitting, preserving the pre-refit official validation score output and verified submission creation at `./submission/submission.csv`.

nodes.code_summary: Data & Preprocessing: Verifies zero sample/slide/group leakage between train (13,200) and validation (3,600) splits, fits training-only LAB/H&E stain statistics, and applies a center- and slide-balanced WeightedRandomSampler. Augmentations: Uses lossless D4 dihedral transforms, cross-center Reinhard LAB interpolation/extrapolation, Beer-Lambert H&E optical density perturbations, microscopy blur/contrast jitter, and RandomErasing. Architecture & Training: Employs a pretrained convnext_small.fb_in22k_ft_in1k backbone with early-stage MixStyle hooks, multi-scale GAP + Gated Spatial Attention pooling across stages 2 and 3, and a Multi-Sample Dropout head; trained with bfloat16 AMP, AdamW with differential learning rates, warmup-cosine scheduling, ModelEMA, and label-smoothed BCE plus class-conditional Deep CORAL loss. Validation & Inference: Selects the best checkpoint on validation balanced accuracy, evaluates with 8x D4-TTA logit averaging, and performs a post-selection refit on train+val blended 0.60/0.40 with the validated model for final test predictions.

nodes.code_summary: The code loads 256x256 histopathology patches with strict leakage checks, computes center- and slide-balanced sampling weights, and fits training-only LAB/H&E stain statistics. During training, it generates paired anchor and strongly domain-augmented views (D4 dihedral symmetries, cross-center Reinhard LAB transfer, Beer-Lambert H&E optical density perturbations, optics jitter, and random erasing) and trains a pretrained ConvNeXt-Small backbone with early-stage MixStyle hooks, multi-scale GAP plus gated spatial attention pooling, and a multi-sample dropout head. Optimization uses AdamW with differential learning rates, warmup-cosine scheduling, bfloat16 AMP, Model EMA, and a combined loss of label-smoothed BCE, class-conditional Deep CORAL, and paired logit/feature consistency. Validation is performed strictly on the fixed validation split with 8x D4-TTA on the best checkpoint, followed by an optional full train+val refit blended for final test inference.

nodes.plan: I merged the three pipeline steps into a single self-contained Python script organized sequentially into physics-informed histopathology data processing and stain standardization (Step 1), the BatchNorm-free `DualStreamStainViT` architecture with composite domain-generalizing loss, LLRD AdamW optimization, and Model EMA (Step 2), and mixed-precision training, pre-refit 8-view $D_4$-TTA official validation, time-guarded post-selection train+validation refitting, and verified submission generation (Step 3). Duplicate imports and standalone sanity-check `__main__` blocks from Steps 1 and 2 were removed, `force_refit_bank=True` and device-type-safe AMP handling were ensured so every component executes fresh from raw `./input/` files, and all variable names, tensor interfaces, and pixel-only inference paths align seamlessly through `run_training_and_evaluation()`.

nodes.code_summary: Data preprocessing resizes H&E patches to 252x252, fits train-only LAB/H&E stain statistics, uses a center- and slide-balanced WeightedRandomSampler, and generates paired anchor/domain training views with D4 dihedral symmetry, cross-center Reinhard LAB transfer, Beer-Lambert HED stain perturbation, optical blur/contrast jitter, and random erasing. The model uses a pretrained vit_base_patch14_reg4_dinov2.lvd142m backbone with early spatial-token MixStyle hooks (blocks 1-2), multi-depth token pooling (blocks 8 and 11) fusing CLS, spatial GAP, and gated spatial attention, and a 5-way multi-sample dropout head. Training combines symmetric label-smoothed BCE, class-conditional Deep CORAL, and paired logit/feature consistency losses using AdamW with layer-wise LR decay, warmup-cosine scheduling, bfloat16 AMP, gradient checkpointing, and Model EMA. Validation uses the fixed leakage-free validation split with 8x D4-TTA, followed by a Phase 2 train+val refit blended with the best Phase 1 checkpoint for test inference.

### Bugfix Plan

1. **Fix dynamic image size detection in `_infer_backbone_input_size`**: In `timm`, `VisionTransformer` stores `dynamic_img_size=True` on the backbone and sets `strict_img_size=False` on `patch_embed`, rather than setting a `patch_embed.dynamic_img_size` attribute. Because `_infer_backbone_input_size` only checked `patch_embed.dynamic_img_size`, it fell back to DINOv2's native `518px` resolution instead of the intended `252px` (`18x18` patch grid), causing 2x artificial upsampling and ~4x slower execution (38 minutes total). Updating the check to inspect `backbone.dynamic_img_size`, `patch_embed.dynamic_img_size`, and `not patch_embed.strict_img_size` resolves this cleanly.
2. **Ensure clean, flushed stdout for reliable result parsing**: Remove the duplicate `"c"` prefix in the per-center log summary and explicitly set `flush=True` on the final verification and `Final Validation Score` print statements so stdout is completely flushed before process teardown.

nodes.code_summary: The code loads and validates histopathology patch metadata with strict leakage checks, computes center- and slide-balanced sampling weights, and fits training-only LAB/H&E stain statistics. During training, it generates pixel-aligned paired anchor and domain views using D4 dihedral symmetries, cross-center Reinhard LAB transfer, Beer-Lambert HED stain perturbation, microscopy optics augmentations, and RandomErasing. The model uses a pretrained DINOv2 ViT-Base with register tokens (vit_base_patch14_reg4_dinov2.lvd142m), early spatial-token MixStyle hooks, gradient checkpointing, a 3-depth multi-scale feature pyramid with 2D spatial-context refiners and gated spatial attention pooling, and a multi-sample dropout head. Training uses bfloat16 AMP, layer-wise learning rate decay AdamW, cosine warmup scheduling, EMA, and a combined loss of label-smoothed BCE, class-conditional Deep CORAL, and paired logit/feature consistency. Validation is performed on the fixed holdout split with 1-view monitoring and 8x D4-TTA final evaluation, followed by an optional full-data refit blended with the best validated checkpoint for test inference.

nodes.code_summary: Data preprocessing audits metadata/paths for leakage, fits a training-only StainReferenceBank for LAB virtual-center synthesis and Beer-Lambert H&E optical density (OD) standardization, and uses a slide-tempered center/label-balanced WeightedRandomSampler with physics-informed stain/optics augmentations (D4, virtual-center LAB, Beer-Lambert matrix/concentration jitter) during training and identical deterministic dual-stream RGB+OD tensors with 8-view D4 TTA at evaluation/test. The architecture is a BatchNorm-free DualStreamStainViT pairing a pretrained vit_large_patch14_reg4_dinov2.lvd142m backbone (multi-layer token fusion over blocks 17/19/21/23 + Gated MIL attention pooling) with an InstanceNorm/GroupNorm BeerLambertODBranch, combined via CrossModalGatedFusion into a MultiSampleDropoutHead and a training-only ConditionalDomainDiscriminator. Training uses bfloat16 AMP, LLRD AdamW, warmup-cosine scheduling, Model EMA, and a composite label-smoothed BCE + auxiliary OD BCE + V-REx + scheduled CDAN loss, validated on the official validation.csv split via ./input/metric.py before a time-guarded train+val refit and logit-space blend.

nodes.code_summary: Data preprocessing verifies zero sample/slide/group leakage, fits train-only LAB/H&E stain statistics, and uses a center- and slide-balanced WeightedRandomSampler with paired anchor/domain views (D4 dihedral transforms, Reinhard LAB transfer, HED stain perturbation, microscopy optics, and random erasing). The model is a DINOv2 ViT-Base with register tokens (vit_base_patch14_reg4_dinov2.lvd142m), early spatial-token MixStyle hooks, gradient checkpointing, a 3-depth feature pyramid with 2D spatial-context refiners and gated spatial attention pooling, and a multi-sample dropout head. Training optimizes EMA Group-DRO label-smoothed BCE combined with class-conditional Deep CORAL, 1D logit alignment, per-center midpoint zero-anchoring, and symmetric paired consistency losses using layer-wise LR-decayed AdamW, cosine warmup, bfloat16 AMP, and ModelEMA. Validation is strictly evaluated pre-refit on validation.csv with 8x D4-TTA, followed by an optional full train+val refit blended with the validated checkpoint for test inference.

nodes.code_summary: Data preprocessing and feature engineering use a training-only StainReferenceBank to compute canonical LAB and Beer-Lambert optical density (OD) statistics, paired with a dual-stream (RGB + 3-channel H&E OD) dataset, slide-tempered center-label balanced sampling, and paired-view training augmentations (D4 symmetries, scale jitter, virtual-center LAB transfer, Beer-Lambert stain-matrix/concentration perturbation, and scanner optics jitter). The model architecture (DualStreamStainViT) is a BatchNorm-free dual-stream network combining a pretrained DINOv2 ViT-Large backbone with multi-layer token fusion and Gated MIL attention pooling, an InstanceNorm/GroupNorm Beer-Lambert OD CNN branch, cross-modal gated fusion, a multi-sample dropout head, and a training-only Conditional Domain Adversarial Discriminator (CDAN). Training uses mixed-precision bfloat16, AdamW with layer-wise learning rate decay (LLRD), warmup cosine scheduling, Model EMA, and a composite loss combining label-smoothed BCE, auxiliary OD BCE, V-REx inter-center risk variance, CDAN loss, and EMA-guided cross-stain logit/embedding consistency. Validation uses the fixed official train/val split evaluated via ./input/metric.py with 8-view D4 TTA, followed by a time-guarded post-selection refit on train+val blended 45/55 in logit space with the Stage 1 model for final test inference.

nodes.code_summary: Data preprocessing loads histopathology patches with strict slide/group leakage checks, fits train-only LAB/H&E stain statistics, and uses center- and slide-balanced weighted sampling with paired anchor/domain views combining D4 dihedral transforms, cross-center Reinhard LAB transfer, Beer-Lambert H&E stain perturbation, optics augmentations, and random erasing. Two LayerNorm-only architectures—DINOv2 ViT-B/14 with register tokens (252x252, early spatial-token MixStyle, 2D spatial-context refiner, 3-depth gated attention pooling) and ConvNeXt-Base (256x256, 4D MixStyle, 3-stage GAP/max/gated attention pooling)—are trained with EMA, AdamW with layer-wise LR decay, warmup-cosine scheduling, and a composite loss combining EMA Group-DRO label-smoothed BCE, class-conditional Deep CORAL, 1D logit alignment, midpoint zero-anchoring, and paired-view logit/feature consistency. nodes.code_summary: Data preprocessing fits a training-only StainReferenceBank and constructs a dual-stream input of ImageNet-normalized RGB patches and Beer-Lambert optical density (Hematoxylin, Eosin, Residual) tensors, using paired-view unseen-center stain augmentation (virtual-center LAB transfer, Beer-Lambert stain-matrix/concentration jitter, scanner optics jitter) and a slide-tempered balanced sampler. The model architecture (DualStreamStainViT) pairs a BatchNorm-free pretrained RGB backbone (DINOv2 ViT-Large with multi-layer token fusion or OpenCLIP ConvNeXt-Large with Stage-3/Stage-4 multi-scale fusion) and Gated MIL spatial attention with an InstanceNorm/GroupNorm Beer-Lambert OD CNN branch, cross-modal gated fusion, and a multi-sample dropout head. Training uses bfloat16 mixed precision, LLRD AdamW with warmup cosine scheduling, Model EMA, and a composite loss combining label-smoothed BCE, auxiliary OD BCE, V-REx inter-center risk variance, CDAN domain adversarial loss, and EMA-guided cross-stain logit/embedding consistency. Validation evaluates each architecture on the fixed official train/val split using identical 8-view D4 TTA and ensembles them 50/50 in logit space, followed by a time-guarded post-selection Train+Val refit.

nodes.code_summary: The pipeline validates leakage-free train/validation splits with slide- and center-balanced sampling weights and fits train-only LAB/H&E stain statistics for paired anchor/domain views using D4 dihedral symmetry, Reinhard LAB transfer, Beer-Lambert H&E perturbation, and optics augmentations. Models are trained with AdamW, layer-wise LR decay, cosine warmup, AMP (bfloat16), gradient checkpointing, and Model EMA, then evaluated and ensembled via 0.50/0.50 logit averaging with 8x D4-TTA.

nodes.code_summary: Data preprocessing and feature engineering use a leakage-free training-only StainReferenceBank, Beer-Lambert H&E optical density (OD) deconvolution, slide-tempered (center, label)-balanced sampling, and paired-view unseen-center augmentation (virtual-center LAB transfer, H&E stain-matrix/concentration perturbation, and scanner optics jitter) alongside deterministic 8-view D4 TTA for evaluation. The model architecture (DualStreamStainViT) is a BatchNorm-free dual-stream network combining a pretrained RGB backbone (Kaiko DINOv2 ViT-Large with multi-layer token fusion or OpenCLIP ConvNeXt-Large with Stage-3/4 multi-scale fusion) and Gated MIL spatial attention with an InstanceNorm/GroupNorm Beer-Lambert OD CNN branch via bidirectional cross-modal gated fusion and a multi-sample dropout head. Training uses bfloat16 mixed precision, LLRD AdamW with cosine warmup, Model EMA, and a composite domain-generalizing loss combining label-smoothed BCE, auxiliary OD BCE, V-REx inter-center risk variance, Conditional Domain Adversarial (CDAN) loss, and EMA-guided cross-stain logit/embedding consistency. Validation evaluates the pre-refit 50/50 logit-space ensemble on the fixed official validation split using ./input/metric.py (balanced accuracy at threshold 0.5), followed by time-guarded post-selection Train+Val refits blended 0.45/0.55 with pre-refit test logits for the final submission.

Training uses paired clean-anchor and strongly augmented domain views (D4 dihedral, cross-center Reinhard LAB transfer, Beer-Lambert H&E perturbation, optical blur/contrast, and random erasing) to train two LayerNorm-only backbones sequentially: DINOv2 ViT-L/14 (with early spatial-token MixStyle, 2D spatial-context refiner, and 3-depth gated attention pyramid) and ConvNeXt-V2-Large (with 4D early MixStyle and 3-stage gated attention pyramid). Models are trained with EMA teacher-student consistency, EMA Group-DRO label-smoothed BCE, class-conditional Deep CORAL, 1D logit alignment, midpoint zero-anchoring, and layer/stage-wise AdamW decay, then combined via an equal-weight 8x D4-TTA logit ensemble.

nodes.code_summary: Data preprocessing validates leakage-free splits, fits train-only LAB/H&E stain statistics, and uses slide- and center-balanced weighted sampling with paired anchor/domain views (D4 dihedral symmetries, cross-center Reinhard LAB transfer, Beer-Lambert HED stain perturbation, microscopy optics, and RandomErasing). The model architecture wraps pure LayerNorm-only Vision Transformers (DINOv2 ViT-L/14 and SigLIP ViT-L/16-256) with early spatial-token MixStyle, a 3-depth 2D spatial-context feature pyramid with gated spatial attention pooling, and a multi-sample dropout head. Training uses AdamW with layer-wise LR decay, cosine warmup, EMA, gradient checkpointing, and a domain-invariant loss combining Group-DRO label-smoothed BCE, memory-bank class-conditional CORAL, 1D logit alignment, midpoint zero-anchoring, and paired-view consistency, followed by top-3 trajectory weight soup selection, 8x D4-TTA validation/test inference, and a 0.50/0.50 logit ensemble.

nodes.plan: I merged the three pipeline steps into a single, self-contained Python script organized sequentially into data loading, Beer-Lambert 40-D morphological feature extraction, and cross-center Fourier augmentation (Step 1), the BatchNorm-free `MorphGatedSwinV2` architecture with `CrossCenterMixStyle`, `DomainInvariantHistoLoss`, LLRD AdamW optimization, and warmup-aware `ModelEMA` (Step 2), and mixed-precision training, pre-refit official 8-view $D_4$-TTA validation, time-guarded train+validation refitting, and verified submission generation (Step 3). Duplicate imports and standalone sanity-check `__main__` blocks from Steps 1 and 2 were removed, fresh feature extraction from `./input/` and safe Fourier crop radius bounds were ensured, and all cross-step interfaces connect cleanly through `run_training_and_evaluation()`.

nodes.code_summary: The pipeline loads train/val/test metadata with leakage checks, extracts 40-D stain- and D4-invariant morphological features via adaptive Beer-Lambert H&E deconvolution (scaled with training-fitted RobustScaler and StandardScaler), and applies D4 symmetry, cross-center Fourier amplitude mixing (FACT), H&E stain perturbation, and optics augmentations with slide-balanced sampling. The model (MorphGatedSwinV2) pairs a pretrained SwinV2-Small backbone with Cross-Center MixStyle, multi-scale spatial attention + average pooling, a residual MLP morphology encoder, FiLM + gated cross-modal fusion, and multi-sample dropout. Training uses AdamW with layer-wise learning rate decay, cosine warmup, EMA, and a composite loss (label-smoothed BCE, V-REx, class-conditional center alignment, pairwise margin ranking, and auxiliary heads), evaluated via fixed validation with 8-view D4-TTA followed by a post-selection Train+Val refit blended for final test inference.

nodes.code_summary: The pipeline performs Beer-Lambert optical density (OD) stain deconvolution, fits a training-only StainReferenceBank for tissue-masked LAB canonical standardization and virtual-center stain perturbation, extracts 46-dim OD morphological descriptors, and constructs leakage-free 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold and 2-fold LOCO splits. It extracts multi-layer D4-averaged [CLS, Mean, GeM-3, Max] embeddings from three strictly frozen pathology foundation models (owkin/phikon-v2, Kaiko ViT-L/14-reg4, and histai/hibou-L with Kaiko ViT-B/8 fallback) and trains four complementary downstream paradigms: a frozen-backbone Phikon-v2 Spatial-MIL probe with DualPrototypeCosineHead, a MultiPFMDomainInvariantMLP with twin stain consistency, a CenterDebiasedLogisticProbe, and fold-internal LightGBM/XGBoost GBDTs on SVD, leave-one-slide-out prototype, and OD features. Finally, it jointly optimizes canonical blend alpha and bounded simplex logit weights strictly on train.csv (0.60*LOCO + 0.40*OOF balanced accuracy), evaluates the locked ensemble on validation.csv, and runs a time-guarded 5-fold Train+Val refit blended 0.35/0.65 with pre-refit test logits.

nodes.code_summary: Data preprocessing and feature engineering extract 40-D stain- and D4-invariant morphological features via Beer-Lambert optical density and Ruifrok-Johnston H&E deconvolution (scaled with training-only RobustScaler and StandardScaler), alongside a training-only FourierStyleBank (FACT), physics-guided H&E stain perturbation, optical jitter, and slide/center-balanced sampling. The model architecture (MorphGatedHistoNet) pairs three BatchNorm-free hierarchical timm backbones (SwinV2-Small, ConvNeXtV2-Base, CAFormer-S18) with Cross-Center MixStyle, MIL-style Spatial Attention + Average Pooling, a residual MorphologyEncoder, FiLM + gated cross-modal fusion, and Multi-Sample Dropout. Training uses Cross-Center Dual-Modality Mixup, a composite domain-invariant loss (label-smoothed BCE, soft GroupDRO, per-center logit-midpoint calibration, V-REx, class-conditional center alignment, pairwise margin ranking, and auxiliary heads), LLRD AdamW, cosine warmup scheduling, and Model EMA. Validation uses a leakage-checked fixed validation split with 8-view D4-TTA, constrained simplex ensemble weight optimization on official fixed-0.5 balanced accuracy, and time-guarded correlation-gated Train+Val refits.
